title: Chain Creeper Explosions
description: A plugin the makes creepers ignite after an explosion or after being lit on fire
body:
Ever wondered why creepers don't explode after another one explodes next to them? I did.

This is a plugin that makes creepers explode in chains or when being lit on fire.
